Article Title: Microsoft will shut down To Do in June 2027 and is asking some of its users to pick another app
Article Text:
Microsoft To Do users on personal accounts have until June 30, 2027, to find a new app

Planner gets To Do's work users, but not their tasks, offline access or list groups

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Wunderlist users who moved to To Do in 2020 now have to move again

Microsoft is retiring its To Do app on June 30, 2027, and people using it with a personal Microsoft account get no replacement, even if they pay for Microsoft 365 Personal or Family. The shutdown covers To Do on Windows, Mac, iOS, Android and the web. Work and school users will be moved to Planner, but their existing tasks and lists will not migrate with them.Microsoft disclosed the change on November 18, at the end of a long Planner blog post published during its Ignite conference. Its support page gives personal users one line of advice: "Choose another task-management application that meets your needs."Work users can see their old To Do tasks inside Planner until the deadline. After that, access ends. Shared lists, their members and their permissions will not carry over. Microsoft has promised an export tool but has not shared instructions yet. It also warns that exported data may not import into Planner or any other app. Retiring the apps does not by itself delete user data.Planner also lacks several To Do features. Microsoft has no plans for native Planner apps on Windows or Mac, and the web and Teams versions don't offer the same offline access.Private tasks can't take file attachments for now, list groups have no equivalent, and there are no plans for printing or emailing a list. The old Tasks feature in classic Outlook, meanwhile, will keep working.The move folds To Do and Planner into one system tied to Copilot and AI agents. "As we bring personal task management into Planner, we will phase out To Do," the Planner team wrote. Howard Crow, Microsoft's director of product for agents and AI, said the company recognises the change will affect customers differently, "particularly those using personal Microsoft accounts."To Do grew out of Wunderlist, which Microsoft picked up in 2015 when it bought the Berlin startup 6Wunderkinder for a reported $100 million to $200 million. The Wunderlist team built To Do, and Microsoft shut Wunderlist down in May 2020, moving its users over.Wunderlist founder Christian Reber, who now runs the rival app Superlist, replied on X: "I'd love to buy it back anytime!" Superlist already offers a To Do importer, and TickTick has posted a migration guide. Former Microsoft executive Brad Silverberg, who led Windows 95 development, said he has used To Do every day and is now looking at TickTick and Todoist.
Article Summary: Microsoft is retiring its To Do app on June 30, 2027. Work users can see their old To Do tasks inside Planner until the deadline. After that, access ends. Microsoft has no plans for native Planner apps on Windows or Mac.

Why smaller Burmese pythons climb trees more often

How Florida's robot rabbits helped detect Burmese pythons

How many Burmese pythons have been removed in Florida

In 2025, Florida introduced solar-powered robot rabbits to tackle its growing population of invasive Burmese pythons. Now, a new study has revealed when and how these snakes climb trees, giving wildlife officials another clue to help locate and remove them. Researchers tracked 346 Burmese pythons, including 188 adults and 158 juveniles, in Big Cypress National Preserve between 2017 and 2024. According to the US Geological Survey (USGS), the study recorded more than 4,000 habitat data points to understand how the snakes use their surroundings.The findings showed that Burmese pythons mostly stay on the ground, with less than 3% of all sightings involving tree climbing. However, around 17% of juvenile pythons and 14% of adult pythons were spotted climbing trees at least once during the study.Researchers found that juvenile pythons were more likely to climb trees than adults. Their smaller size and lighter weight may make it easier for them to move along branches. As a python grows heavier, its likelihood of climbing trees decreases. This means wildlife workers may need to look beyond the ground when searching for smaller invasive snakes.The findings could help improve python removal efforts because the snakes are already difficult to spot in Florida's dense vegetation.In 2025, the South Florida Water Management District and the University of Florida introduced solar-powered robotic rabbit decoys to attract Burmese pythons. The robots mimic real prey by producing a heat signature and emitting a scent designed to attract snakes. They are also equipped with AI-powered cameras that monitor the surrounding area and alert officials when a python approaches. A trained removal agent can then be sent to capture the snake.“These innovative robots produce a heat signature and emit a smell designed to attract pythons. The robots are equipped with cameras that monitor for pythons and notify District officials when a snake is detected. Once notified, the District can dispatch a python removal agent to the area,” the district said.Notably, Burmese pythons are not native to Florida and are found in and around the Everglades, where they prey on birds, mammals and other reptiles, according to the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC). Florida also organises the annual Florida Python Challenge, a 10-day competition that brings together professional and amateur hunters to capture the invasive snakes. In the 2026 challenge, 907 participants from 30 states, as well as Vietnam and Canada, removed 280 Burmese pythons.Since 2017, contractors working with the FWC and South Florida Water Management District have removed more than 19,000 Burmese pythons so far.The latest study adds to these efforts by showing that although most Burmese pythons remain on the ground, smaller snakes are more likely to climb trees.
Article Summary: Researchers tracked 346 Burmese pythons, including 188 adults and 158 juveniles, in Big Cypress National Preserve between 2017 and 2024. The study recorded more than 4,000 habitat data points to understand how the snakes use their surroundings. The findings could help improve python removal efforts because the snakes are already difficult to spot in Florida.

Article Title: AI just cracked math’s most famous problem, says Anthropic mathematician; here’s how Google CEO Sundar Pichai reacted
Article Text:
CEO of Anthropic Dario Amodei.

A 167-year-old maths problem

Claude helped generate a massive proof

Google CEO Sundar Pichai’s reaction

The timing

Just days after Dario Amodei-led Anthropic made its historic public market debut, one of the company's mathematicians has made an even more extraordinary claim: that he has solved the Riemann Hypothesis, widely regarded as the most famous unsolved problem in mathematics, with the help of Anthropic's AI model Claude. According to a Wall Street Journal report cited by the user, Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge said he believes he has discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, a landmark conjecture in number theory that has resisted attempts by mathematicians since it was first proposed in 1859.Proposed in 1859, the Riemann hypothesis has defeated the best human minds ever since. It became known as the field’s holy grail when it was chosen as one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems in 2000, and even the most capable AI models hadn’t managed it. Alpöge posted his proof on his website in Lean, a programming language that lets computers check an argument line by line. Mathematicians immediately began working through it. He said the full argument is “incredibly long” and called the AI-written version “some massive unreadable travesty,” more than 250,000 pages.Alpöge revealed that the proof was developed with assistance from Claude, Anthropic's AI system.He published the work in Lean, a programming language and proof assistant designed to allow computers to verify mathematical arguments line by line. According to Alpöge, the complete proof is extraordinarily lengthy. He described the AI-generated version as an "incredibly long" argument spanning more than 250,000 pages. Mathematicians began reviewing the proof soon after it was published, attempting to verify whether the reasoning holds up under scrutiny. Importantly, the proof has not yet been formally accepted by the mathematical community. Independent verification will be required before the result can be considered proven.The announcement quickly drew attention across the technology industry, including from Sundar Pichai, CEO of Google and Alphabet. Reacting to the claim on X, Pichai wrote: "Somewhere Euler, Gauss and Riemann in awe today!" The remark referenced three of the most influential figures in mathematical history: Leonhard Euler, Carl Friedrich Gauss and Bernhard Riemann, whose work laid the foundations for large parts of modern mathematics.Alpöge said the result came late Sunday into Monday, days before Anthropic went public. He called the timing “horrible” and said he messaged CEO Dario Amodei to ask permission to announce it, noting there was a constraint to respect. Anthropic didn’t respond to a request for comment after his post, as its stock fell 13.04% on its first full day of trading.“I just could not live if I waited even longer,” he wrote. He added that he hoped the argument offers “a glimpse towards the miracles that lie ahead.”

Article Title: GTA 6 PC scam alert: $200 malware kit targets gamers with fake downloads and crypto theft
Article Text:
A still from GTA 6. Image via: Rockstar Games

GTA 6 PC scam kit uses fake downloads to steal sensitive data

How to spot a fake GTA 6 download and protect your computer

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

GTA 6 fans waiting for a PC release have become targets of a dangerous online scam. Cybersecurity researchers have uncovered a $200 malware package that uses fake game downloads to trick players into infecting their computers. The toolkit reportedly combines account-stealing software, cryptocurrency theft tools and hidden mining programmes. With Rockstar Games yet to announce a native PC version, the promise of an unofficial download could cost players far more than they expect. The threat also reaches beyond gaming, potentially putting personal email, financial accounts and workplace information at risk.NordVPN’s Threat Intelligence team discovered the toolkit on November 16, three days before GTA 6 launched on consoles. According to the findings, the package was advertised on the dark web for $200, with buyers able to pay using Bitcoin or Tether.The toolkit reportedly includes several malicious programmes. One executable, named GTA6 Keygen.exe, is designed to capture browser session cookies. These files help websites keep users signed in. If criminals steal them, they may be able to access accounts without entering passwords or completing another two-factor authentication check.The package also contains a cryptocurrency wallet drainer targeting networks such as Ethereum, Solana, Polygon and BNB Smart Chain. Another component uses XMRig software to mine cryptocurrency secretly by consuming the victim’s computer resources.It even includes an automated YouTube Shorts tool that can promote fraudulent download links. This could help scammers reach more gamers through videos that appear connected to GTA 6.Rockstar has released the game for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, but has not announced a native PC version. Official cloud streaming on supported Xbox devices does not provide an installable PC copy.A website claiming to offer a free GTA 6 PC installer should raise immediate suspicion. Other warning signs include unofficial game ports, key generators, cracked files and links shared through unfamiliar social media accounts. Players should also avoid downloads that ask them to disable antivirus protection or connect a crypto wallet to unlock access.If you have downloaded a suspicious file but have not opened it, delete it and run a security scan. If you have already executed it, disconnect the computer from the internet and scan it with updated security software.Use a separate, trusted device to change important passwords, especially for email and banking accounts. Also sign out of active sessions, revoke unfamiliar devices and check financial and crypto accounts for unusual activity. If the computer connects to workplace systems, inform the organisation’s IT team.The discovery follows an earlier campaign involving fake GTA 6 demo websites that distributed Vidar malware. The latest findings suggest scammers are now packaging several harmful tools into one product. Until Rockstar announces an official PC release, players should treat any downloadable GTA 6 installer as a potential threat.

With Rockstar Games yet to announce a native PC version, the promise of an unofficial download could cost players far more than they expect.

Jaguar Type 01 revealed: 0-62mph in 3.2 seconds, 450-mile range and luxury cabin

A modern cabin with new technology

What does the Type 01 name mean?

When will the Jaguar Type 01 go on sale?

Jaguar on Friday unveiled the Type 01, an all-electric luxury car that marks a new beginning for the British carmaker. Revealed in New York City, the four-door grand tourer combines high performance with modern design and new technology. One of the car's biggest highlights is its acceleration. It can go from 0 to 62 mph in just 3.2 seconds. It has three electric motors that produce 1,030PS of power and 1,365Nm of torque.The Type 01 is Jaguar's new flagship electric car. It comes with a 118kWh usable battery pack and offers a claimed range of up to 400 miles under US EPA testing. Its range is up to 450 miles (720km) under WLTP testing.The car uses an 850-volt electrical system that supports fast charging. When connected to a 350kW DC fast charger, it can add 200 miles of range in just 13 minutes.ID@undefined Caption not available.Built on Jaguar's new Electric Architecture (JEA), the Type 01 has been designed to offer a balance of performance and comfort. Its design includes a low roof, a long bonnet, a short front overhang and large 23-inch wheels. The car also has a 50:50 weight distribution, which is aimed at improving handling.Jaguar has also added intelligent torque vectoring and active aerodynamics to improve performance. These features include movable air vents and a rear spoiler that can extend in three stages. The car has a drag coefficient of 0.23, helping it move through the air more efficiently.The Type 01 has a cabin designed around luxury and technology. A central section divides the interior into four separate areas.The cabin features brass-effect aluminium trim, a 24-inch OLED driver display made from a single piece of glass and a separate 7-inch touchscreen. It also gets a full-width panoramic soundbar and seats with audio features designed to improve the listening experience.Jaguar says the name Type 01 reflects both its history and its future. The word "Type" pays tribute to famous models from the brand's past. The number "0" represents zero emissions, while "1" marks the first car of its new generation.The car also benefits from technology developed through Jaguar TCS Racing's Formula E programme, which has won two world championships.The Type 01 can accelerate from 62 mph to 112 mph (100km/h to 180km/h) in just 4.0 seconds.Designed, engineered and manufactured in the UK, the Type 01 is an important part of Jaguar's move towards becoming a fully electric luxury car brand. Prices start at £130,000, with the US price listed at $130,500. Higher-specification versions and customised models are expected to cost more than £150,000.Jaguar plans to open order books in early 2027, with the first customer deliveries expected in the second half of the year.Also read: Sebastien Buemi ends full-time Formula E career, stays with Envision as advisor

Article Title: Formula E names COMSOL its Official Multiphysics Partner in new multi-year deal
Article Text:
Formula E and Comsol

Formula E joins hands with COMSOL to boost electric racing technology

AI and digital twins also in focus

GEN4 to bring bigger technology demands

Formula E on Thursday announced a new multi-year partnership with COMSOL, which will become the Official Multiphysics Partner of the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship. The partnership brings together Formula E, the world's leading all-electric motorsport championship, and COMSOL, a company known for its multiphysics simulation and computer-aided engineering software. As part of the partnership, Formula E and COMSOL engineers will use COMSOL Multiphysics to study complex engineering problems involving several physical systems working together.Electric race cars depend on several systems at the same time. These include electrical, thermal, structural, electromagnetic, fluid and battery systems.All these systems have to work together under tough performance and energy limits. COMSOL will provide Formula E's technology teams with simulation software and technical expertise to help them understand how these different physical effects interact.ID@undefined Caption not available.The partnership will also look at simulation apps and digital twin technology. The aim is to make engineering information easier to use outside the traditional modelling process.Bjorn Sjodin, SVP of Product Management at COMSOL, said, “Formula E is a great example of why multiphysics simulation matters, as multiple phenomena are at play and constantly interact with one another.We are excited to work directly with Formula E's technology team and put COMSOL Multiphysics to work on these kinds of real-world challenges.”Formula E CTO Dan Cherowbrier said the partnership will strengthen the championship's engineering capabilities.“Technology is at the heart of Formula E, so partnering with COMSOL makes real sense for us and truly enhances our engineering skillsets. COMSOL gives us a powerful environment for understanding complex systems where many different physical effects are connected, but the opportunity goes beyond individual simulations. We're particularly interested in how AI-assisted modelling, agentic workflows, and digital twins can help engineers interact with models, explore designs, and make simulation insight more accessible as we continue to push the limits of electric racing,” he said.The partnership comes as Formula E prepares for the next generation of its cars.The GEN4 era will bring greater demands in areas such as speed, efficiency, energy management and vehicle development. It will introduce what Formula E describes as its fastest and most technologically advanced race car so far.COMSOL has also announced COMSOL Multiphysics version 2027, which is scheduled to arrive later this autumn.The new version will include features aimed at advanced engineering work, including dedicated electric motor modelling, system-level simulation, agentic modelling and wider access to tools for creating simulation apps.The partnership was announced at the COMSOL Conference 2026 Boston. Formula E CTO Dan Cherowbrier also delivered a keynote speech at the event, discussing the technology and engineering that could shape the future of Formula E.
Article Summary: Formula E joins hands with COMSOL to boost electric racing technology. Aim is to make engineering information easier to use outside the traditional modelling process. AI and digital twins also in focus as Formula E prepares for the next generation of its cars.
